items.title: Sharing AI progress in mathematics
items.summary: OpenAI publishes new results on open problems in mathematics from an internal frontier model and shares Lean proof formalizations and research details on GitHub.
items.titleZh: 分享 AI 在数学领域的进展
items.summaryZh: OpenAI 发布了内部前沿模型在数学未解问题上取得的新成果，并在 GitHub 分享了 Lean 证明形式化内容及研究细节。

items.title: OpenTPU – An open-source AI accelerator, developed by AI
items.summary: An open-source AI accelerator, developed by AI: RTL, ISA, simulator, compiler and profiler in one repo. Runs Qwen3, LFM2.5 and Qwen3.5 on a Kintex-7 PCIe card. - FeSens/openTPU
items.titleZh: OpenTPU——由 AI 开发的开源 AI 加速器
items.summaryZh: 由 AI 开发的开源 AI 加速器：在一个代码仓库中包含 RTL、指令集架构、模拟器、编译器和性能分析器。可在 Kintex-7 PCIe 卡上运行 Qwen3、LFM2.5 和 Qwen3.5。

items.title: Utah to let AI examine patients and prescribe medication without human oversight
items.summary: The good news is that the program is currently very limited in its scope. It's just one year long and only for patients with mild-to-moderate acne.
items.titleZh: 犹他州将允许 AI 在无人类监督下为患者检查并开具处方
items.summaryZh: 好消息是，该计划目前的适用范围非常有限：为期一年，仅面向轻度至中度痤疮患者。

items.title: Penguin Mail – open-source Rust email client for Linux with AI
items.summary: Gmail, Microsoft and any IMAP or POP3 account, with your calendar and contacts, in one fast app on your own computer.
items.titleZh: Penguin Mail——适用于 Linux、内置 AI 的开源 Rust 邮件客户端
items.summaryZh: 在自己的电脑上，通过一款快速应用使用 Gmail、Microsoft 及任何 IMAP 或 POP3 账户，并管理日历和联系人。

items.title: Paramount Skydance has completed its $111B merger with Warner Bros. Discovery
items.titleZh: Paramount Skydance 完成与 Warner Bros. Discovery 的 1110 亿美元合并
items.summaryZh: Paramount Skydance 已完成与 Warner Bros. Discovery 的 1110 亿美元合并。

items.title: AnyPS5: Port PS5 binaries to PC without emulation (87% system libraries mapped)
items.summary: Tool for automatic PS5 executables porting to Linux and Windows - boykopovar/AnyPS5
items.titleZh: AnyPS5：无需模拟即可将 PS5 二进制程序移植到 PC（已映射 87% 的系统库）
items.summaryZh: 用于将 PS5 可执行文件自动移植到 Linux 和 Windows 的工具。

items.title: Decisions API is in public beta
items.summary: Use the Decisions API to check conditions, select from fixed options, and score text and images against a rubric.
items.summaryZh: 使用 Decisions API 检查条件、从固定选项中进行选择，并依据评分标准对文本和图像进行评分。

items.title: Ex-Ramp engineers raise $20M for platform Melius after scrapping their first product
items.summary: Instead of helping marketers manage and optimize ad spend, the company is focusing on building the tools that generate the creative assets and campaigns.
items.titleZh: 前 Ramp 工程师放弃首款产品后，为平台 Melius 筹集 2000 万美元
items.summaryZh: 公司不再帮助营销人员管理和优化广告支出，转而专注于打造用于生成创意素材和营销活动的工具。

items.title: Silicon Valley’s AI wunderkind launches Underdog, the most private Instinct/Muse competitor yet
items.summary: Sigil Wen, backed by a Silicon Valley who's who, has built an on-device AI assistant that promises to be free, fully private, and capable for everyday tasks.
items.titleZh: 硅谷 AI 神童推出 Underdog，称其为迄今隐私保护最强的 Instinct/Muse 竞品
items.summaryZh: 在硅谷众多知名人士支持下，Sigil Wen 打造了一款端侧 AI 助手，承诺免费、充分保护隐私，并能胜任日常任务。

items.title: How AI decision models could change content moderation
items.summary: On Tuesday, Musubi announced a lightweight decision model made for real-time moderation called PolicyLM-1.7B, released with open weights.
items.titleZh: AI 决策模型如何改变内容审核
items.summaryZh: 周二，Musubi 宣布推出专为实时审核打造的轻量级决策模型 PolicyLM-1.7B，并以开放权重形式发布。

items.title: AI computing startup Lambda to raise $4B ahead of planned IPO
items.summary: Nvidia-backed Lambda is raising up to $4 billion at a $14.5 billion pre-money valuation ahead of a planned 2027 IPO, led by Coatue and Blackstone.
items.titleZh: AI 计算初创公司 Lambda 计划 IPO 前筹集 40 亿美元
items.summaryZh: 由 Nvidia 支持的 Lambda 正以 145 亿美元的投前估值筹集至多 40 亿美元，为计划于 2027 年进行的 IPO 做准备；本轮融资由 Coatue 和 Blackstone 领投。

items.title: The next hurdle for AI agents: getting websites to let them in
items.summary: Personal AI agents promise to shop, book flights, and make reservations for you. But deliberate blocks and anti-bot defenses are getting in the way, leaving consumers caught in the middle. A new standard aims to help.
items.titleZh: AI 智能体面临的下一道障碍：如何让网站放行
items.summaryZh: 个人 AI 智能体承诺能替你购物、订机票和预订服务。但网站有意设置的限制和反机器人防护正在阻碍它们，让消费者夹在中间。一项新标准旨在提供帮助。

items.title: Hark releases an AI personal assistant with a focus on privacy
items.summary: The AI lab's personal assistant is an operating system from the future designed to compete with Muse, Dots, and Instinct.
items.titleZh: Hark 推出注重隐私的 AI 个人助理
items.summaryZh: 这家 AI 实验室推出的个人助理是一款面向未来的操作系统，旨在与 Muse、Dots 和 Instinct 竞争。

items.title: Mirror Particle is building a ‘world model’ of human behavior
items.summary: Mirror Particle will launch at TechCrunch Disrupt's Startup Battlefield 200 with a world model built from scratch to predict human behavior, arguing that LLM role-play falls short for market research and brand strategy.
items.titleZh: Mirror Particle 正在构建人类行为“世界模型”
items.summaryZh: Mirror Particle 将携一款从零打造、用于预测人类行为的世界模型，参加 TechCrunch Disrupt 的 Startup Battlefield 200。该公司认为，LLM 角色扮演无法满足市场研究和品牌策略的需求。

items.title: How to find out if Amazon thinks you have ‘flat buttocks’
items.summary: "I stumbled upon a page of assumptions that Amazon has made about me based on my purchases and I’m literally speechless," one shopper wrote on Threads.
items.titleZh: 如何查明 Amazon 是否认为你“臀部扁平”
items.summaryZh: 一位购物者在 Threads 上写道：“我偶然发现一个页面，上面列着 Amazon 根据我的购买记录对我作出的种种推断，我简直说不出话来。”
